title: Daytona USA C.C.E. Net Link Edition
overview:
Daytona USA C.C.E. Net Link Edition is a version of the Daytona USA stock car racer built for the Sega NetLink modem, letting two players race each other over the phone line.

Pick a stock car, each with its own grip, acceleration and top speed, and race for the checkered flag. Online play works by having one Saturn dial the other player's directly, with no central service needed.

- Two-player head-to-head racing over the Sega NetLink
- Based on the Daytona USA Circuit Edition update
